question: For compute/greenmini, does the cheapest paid plan mean the cheapest dedicated rented server (M2 8GB/256GB at EUR 69,00 monthly, EUR 59,00 paid annually) or the cheapest server of any kind including colocation at EUR 44,00 monthly?
why: The 2026-11-25 order page lists colocation from EUR 44,00 monthly as well as dedicated Mac mini servers; the record describes dedicated Apple hardware, so colocation was left out of the confirmed value.
